```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
ReportConcreteCase <- function(liningID, caseID) {
  Data <- if (identical(liningID, "shotcrete")) {
    Calculation$shotcrete$summary
  } else if (identical(liningID, "reinforcedConcrete")) {
    Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$summary
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported concrete lining: ", liningID)
  }
  Row <- Data[Data$caseID == caseID, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(Row) != 1L) {
    stop("Missing concrete result: ", liningID, ".", caseID)
  }
  Row
}
PlainChecks <- utils::read.csv(
  Calculation$paths$shotcreteChecks,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = ""
)
PlainChecks <- PlainChecks[
  PlainChecks$liningID %in% c("shotcrete", "plainConcrete150") &
    PlainChecks$calculationStatus == "calculated",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
PlainCheckPass <- function(liningID, checkID) {
  Data <- PlainChecks[
    PlainChecks$liningID == liningID & PlainChecks$checkID == checkID,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(Data) == 0L) {
    stop("Missing calculated plain-concrete check: ", checkID)
  }
  all(Data$checkStatus == "satisfied")
}
PlainAlternativePass <- function(liningID) {
  PlainCheckPass(liningID, "tension-face") &&
    PlainCheckPass(liningID, "one-way-shear")
}
Plain100Pass <- PlainAlternativePass("shotcrete")
Plain150Pass <- PlainAlternativePass("plainConcrete150")
PlainPass <- Plain100Pass && Plain150Pass
PlainCheckConclusion <- paste0(
  "En las comprobaciones de tracción y corte, la sección simple de 100 mm ",
  if (Plain100Pass) "verifica" else "no verifica",
  " y la sección simple de 150 mm ",
  if (Plain150Pass) "verifica." else "no verifica."
)
PlainGoverningUtilization <- function(liningID, interfaceID) {
  Data <- PlainChecks[
    PlainChecks$liningID == liningID &
      PlainChecks$interfaceID == interfaceID &
      PlainChecks$checkID %in% c("tension-face", "one-way-shear"),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(Data) == 0L || any(!is.finite(Data$utilization))) {
    stop("Missing plain-concrete utilization: ", liningID, ".", interfaceID)
  }
  max(Data$utilization)
}
ReinforcedConcreteStrength <- Calculation$config$additionalLinings$
  reinforcedConcrete$compressiveStrengthMPa
ReinforcedBeta1 <- calculateAci31825Beta1(ReinforcedConcreteStrength)
ReinforcedGradeLabel <- gsub(
  "-",
  " ",
  Calculation$config$additionalLinings$reinforcedConcrete$
    reinforcementGradeID,
  fixed = TRUE
)
ReinforcedSteel <- unique(
  Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$reinforcement[
    c("yieldStrengthMPa", "modulusMPa")
  ]
)
if (nrow(ReinforcedSteel) != 1L) {
  stop("The reinforced-concrete layers must use one steel grade.")
}
StrengthCases <- Calculation$reinforcedConcrete$strengthCases
FormatStrengthFactor <- function(value) {
  gsub(".", ",", formatCalculationGeneral(value), fixed = TRUE)
}
StrengthCasePairs <- paste0(
  "EV ×",
  vapply(
    StrengthCases$verticalStressFactor,
    FormatStrengthFactor,
    character(1)
  ),
  " y EH ×",
  vapply(
    StrengthCases$horizontalStressFactor,
    FormatStrengthFactor,
    character(1)
  )
)
StrengthCaseSentence <- if (length(StrengthCasePairs) == 1L) {
  StrengthCasePairs
} else {
  paste(
    paste(StrengthCasePairs[-length(StrengthCasePairs)], collapse = ", "),
    StrengthCasePairs[length(StrengthCasePairs)],
    sep = " y "
  )
}
ReinforcementStudy <- Calculation$config$additionalLinings$
  reinforcedConcrete$reinforcementStudy
ReinforcementMeshLabels <- vapply(
  ReinforcementStudy$reinforcementCases,
  function(Case) paste0("Ø", Case$barDiameterMm, "/", Case$barSpacingMm),
  character(1)
)
ReinforcementMeshSentence <- if (length(ReinforcementMeshLabels) == 1L) {
  ReinforcementMeshLabels
} else {
  paste(
    paste(head(ReinforcementMeshLabels, -1L), collapse = ", "),
    tail(ReinforcementMeshLabels, 1L),
    sep = " y "
  )
}
FormatSpanishList <- function(Values) {
  Values <- unique(Values)
  if (length(Values) == 0L) {
    return("")
  }
  if (length(Values) == 1L) {
    return(Values)
  }
  paste(
    paste(head(Values, -1L), collapse = ", "),
    tail(Values, 1L),
    sep = " y "
  )
}
ReinforcementCaseLabels <- function(Data) {
  vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(Data)),
    function(RowIndex) {
      Row <- Data[RowIndex, , drop = FALSE]
      Mesh <- paste0("Ø", Row$barDiameterMm, "/", Row$barSpacingMm)
      if (Row$reinforcementArrangementID == "symmetric-two-face") {
        return(paste(Mesh, "en ambas caras"))
      }
      stop("Unsupported reinforcement arrangement in the report.")
    },
    character(1)
  )
}
SensitivityPlain <- utils::read.csv(
  Calculation$paths$sensitivityPlainChecks,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
SensitivitySweep <- utils::read.csv(
  Calculation$paths$sensitivityPmSweep,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
SensitivityModuli <- sort(unique(SensitivityPlain$modulusMPa))
if (length(SensitivityModuli) < 2L) {
  stop("The sensitivity products require at least two moduli.")
}
SensitivityFirst <- SensitivityModuli[1L]
SensitivityLast <- SensitivityModuli[length(SensitivityModuli)]
SensitivityModuliSentence <- paste(
  paste(head(SensitivityModuli, -1L), collapse = ", "),
  tail(SensitivityModuli, 1L),
  sep = " y "
)
SensitivityPlainU <- function(liningID, checkID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivityPlain$utilization[
    SensitivityPlain$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivityPlain$checkID == checkID &
      SensitivityPlain$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L || !is.finite(Value)) {
    stop("Missing plain sensitivity value: ", liningID, ".", checkID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivityPlainTensionRobust <- all(
  SensitivityPlain$utilization[
    SensitivityPlain$checkID == "tension-face"
  ] > 1
)
SensitivitySweep$configurationID <- paste0(
  "S",
  SensitivitySweep$barDiameterMm
)
SensitivityPmStatus <- function(liningID, configurationID, modulus) {
  Value <- SensitivitySweep$localPMStatus[
    SensitivitySweep$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivitySweep$configurationID == configurationID &
      SensitivitySweep$modulusMPa == modulus
  ]
  if (length(Value) != 1L) {
    stop("Missing P-M sensitivity status: ", liningID, ".", configurationID)
  }
  Value
}
SensitivityConfigIDs <- function(liningID) {
  AUX <- SensitivitySweep[
    SensitivitySweep$liningID == liningID &
      SensitivitySweep$modulusMPa == SensitivityFirst,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  AUX$configurationID[order(AUX$reinforcementCaseOrder)]
}
SensitivityFlips <- function(liningID) {
  IDs <- SensitivityConfigIDs(liningID)
  IDs[vapply(IDs, function(s) {
    SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, SensitivityFirst) !=
      SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, SensitivityLast)
  }, logical(1))]
}
SensitivityPassing <- function(liningID, modulus) {
  IDs <- SensitivityConfigIDs(liningID)
  IDs[vapply(IDs, function(s) {
    identical(SensitivityPmStatus(liningID, s, modulus), "satisfied")
  }, logical(1))]
}
SensitivityPassSentence <- function(liningID, modulus, object = FALSE) {
  IDs <- SensitivityPassing(liningID, modulus)
  Object <- if (object) " la flexocompresión " else " "
  if (length(IDs) == 0L) {
    return(paste0("ninguna configuración satisface", Object))
  }
  paste0(
    if (length(IDs) == 1L) "satisface" else "satisfacen",
    Object,
    FormatSpanishList(IDs)
  )
}
ReinforcementConclusion <- function(liningID) {
  Data <- Calculation[[liningID]]$reinforcementSweep$summary
  Labels <- ReinforcementCaseLabels(Data)
  CheckLabels <- c(
    localPMStatus = "flexocompresión P–M",
    shearStatus = "corte unidireccional"
  )
  Pass <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(Data)),
    function(RowIndex) {
      all(Data[RowIndex, names(CheckLabels), drop = TRUE] == "satisfied")
    },
    logical(1)
  )
  Thickness <- formatCalculationFixed(
    1000 * Calculation[[liningID]]$section$thicknessM,
    0L
  )
  PassingClause <- if (any(Pass)) {
    paste0(
      FormatSpanishList(Labels[Pass]),
      if (sum(Pass) == 1L) " satisface" else " satisfacen",
      " ambas comprobaciones"
    )
  } else {
    "ninguna configuración satisface ambas comprobaciones"
  }
  FailureDetails <- vapply(
    which(!Pass),
    function(RowIndex) {
      Failed <- CheckLabels[
        Data[RowIndex, names(CheckLabels), drop = TRUE] != "satisfied"
      ]
      paste0(
        Labels[RowIndex],
        " no satisface ",
        FormatSpanishList(unname(Failed))
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )
  FailureClause <- if (length(FailureDetails) == 0L) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste0("; ", paste(FailureDetails, collapse = "; "))
  }
  paste0(
    "Para la sección de ", Thickness, " mm, ",
    PassingClause, FailureClause, "."
  )
}
```

# Verificación del liner de shotcrete {#sec-calculation-concrete}

Este capítulo evalúa el shotcrete como revestimiento estructural independiente
de la chapa. Para las secciones de 100 y 150 mm comprueba la respuesta del
hormigón simple y compara familias resistentes P–M
con mallas Ø8/150, Ø10/150 y Ø12/150 en ambas caras. El objetivo es
determinar, sin adoptar
una armadura final, qué configuraciones satisfacen por separado la
flexocompresión, el corte unidireccional y el desprendimiento radial.
